subject: Payment hold clauses & vendor certification package
messages:
From: Sophie Lemaire <sophie.lemaire@novacorp.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@novacorp.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jul 2028 10:14:00 +0100
Subject: New supplier: PO 78932 — payment hold clauses & certs needed

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for sending over the signed order. Attached is PO 78932 for the upcoming deployment. Before we can activate payments in our AP system we need a few items completed from Redwood: 

- Completed vendor registration in our NovaPortal (link below)
- Certificate of insurance (COI) showing professional liability; minimum coverage: EUR 1M
- VAT registration number (for EU invoicing) or valid tax form if non‑EU
- Signed acknowledgement of our Payment Hold clause (see section 4 on the PO)

To be explicit on the payment hold: NovaCorp places invoices on a 45‑day acceptance hold for new vendors for the first two billing cycles (this is a hold on disbursement, not on invoice submission). We release payment once the acceptance window closes or upon written acceptance from the ordering manager. Please confirm Redwood is ok with that flow or propose alternate acceptance criteria.

Attachments: NovaCorp_PO_78932.pdf (application/pdf), Vendor_Cert_Checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Portal (vendor enroll): https://novaportal.example.com/vendor-enroll/78932

Please let me know estimated timing for onboarding (we'd like invoices to flow by Aug 1).

Best,

Sophie Lemaire
Senior AP Operations Manager
NovaCorp

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jul 2028 09:02:00 +0100
Subject: Re: New supplier: PO 78932 — payment hold clauses & certs needed

Hi Sophie — thanks for the PO and the checklist. Quick clarifications so we can get everything uploaded correctly:

1) Bank/remit details: do you require a specific file format for our banking mandate? We generally provide an IBAN + SWIFT and an EFT mandate PDF.
2) Self‑billing: the PO references "self‑billing options" in section 3A. Does NovaCorp prefer Redwood to issue invoices per PO (standard) or enroll Redwood into NovaCorp self‑billing (NovaCorp issues invoices on our behalf)? That affects the VAT documentation needed.
3) The 45‑day acceptance hold — is the hold applied per invoice date or per acceptance signoff? In other words, if an invoice is submitted on July 25 but acceptance is confirmed Aug 2, which cycle governs release?

Looping in Laura from Finance and Naomi on Compliance to help gather COI and VAT proof. We'll aim to complete the upload within 3 business days once we confirm the remit and self‑billing route.

Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +44 20 5555 1234

From: Sophie Lemaire <sophie.lemaire@novacorp.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@novacorp.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jul 2028 11:27:00 +0100
Subject: Re: New supplier: PO 78932 — payment hold clauses & certs needed

Hi Rafael — answers below, and sorry for the rapid back and forth.

1) Banking: IBAN + BIC in PDF is fine. We accept an EFT mandate PDF or a bank letter. For EU suppliers we also ask for the company legal name to match the invoice header.
2) Self‑billing: For this engagement please invoice Redwood as vendor (standard flow). We will not activate NovaCorp self‑billing for third‑party SaaS vendors on this PO. That means VAT number is required for the invoice if Redwood is VAT‑registered in the EU.
3) Payment hold: The hold is applied per invoice submission date. If an invoice is submitted July 25 it remains subject to the 45‑day hold from that invoice date unless manual acceptance is signed earlier by the ordering manager.

I'll attach the vendor portal invite and a one‑page acceptance template you can sign to speed up release in edge cases. If you upload the COI + VAT ID and confirm in the portal we can prioritise the account verification (we typically move verified vendors to the "priority" queue).

Portal onboarding link (same): https://novaportal.example.com/vendor-enroll/78932
DocuSign vendor invite: https://novaportal.example.com/docusign/INVITE-78932

Attachments (sent on portal): vendor_enroll_invite.html, acceptance_template.pdf

Thanks — aim for uploads by Mon (15 July) and we'll route to verification.

Best,

Sophie Lemaire
Senior AP Operations Manager
NovaCorp

Team — forwarding NovaCorp thread. Action items and proposed owners below (we need this in the portal by EOD Tue):

- Laura (Finance): prepare sample invoice template referencing PO 78932 + our banking/EFT mandate PDF. Make sure "Bill To" legal name matches Redwood's company record (use Redwood Inference Ltd, VAT GB123456789).
- Naomi (Compliance): compile COI and VAT registration proof. I'll attach the COI and certificate bundle when ready. Confirm whether the COI wording meets NovaCorp's EUR 1M professional liability requirement.
- Marcus (Ops): once Naomi confirms, please upload all docs to NovaPortal and mark the vendor as "upload complete". Attach a ZIP of the submitted certificates in our internal folder for auditing (vendor-certificates.zip).

Sophie confirmed NovaCorp uses a 45‑day invoice hold applied from invoice submission, and they will not enable self‑billing for this PO. If we want faster release in exception cases we can sign their one‑page acceptance template; advise if we should sign that now or wait until the first invoice is reviewed.
